cp_audit.rule: At least 50*(degree+1) rows, 20 ILs, and half of ILs with >=2*(degree+1) distinct temperatures; maximum cubic.

protocol: User-chosen full-corpus third-pass encoder; fixed cross-ion attention; all 11 properties. Five seeds on one frozen split. Equal-task loss and per-task label budget. Structure-only single-task heads are aliased, not independently refitted. Single-task validation selection is per property; multitask selection uses one equal-property validation mean. Heat-capacity head comparison also changes pressure input. No fixed-compute or fresh-test claim.
